description.value: Jade Seafood Restaurant (玉庭軒) is an award-winning Cantonese dining destination in Richmond's commercial heart, recognized multiple times by the Chinese Restaurant Awards for both its cuisine and service. The restaurant offers dim sum, dinner, and take-out menus alongside banquet facilities with private rooms that can seat up to 20 tables. A touring cyclist arriving in Richmond's busy Number 3 Road corridor will find a full-service sit-down meal or a take-out option with a substantial menu rooted in authentic Cantonese seafood cooking.

address.value: 2811 No. 3 Road, Unit 280, Richmond, BC V6X 2B2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, award-winning Cantonese seafood restaurant at 2811 No. 3 Road, Richmond with phone 604-249-0082; looks_closed=false and current promotions/menus corroborate it is open. The website lists Unit 280 while OSM records Unit 208 — a clear discrepancy flagged in concerns. Takeout is confirmed by dedicated Take-Out menu sections on the website; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Unit number discrepancy: OSM records addr:unit=208, but website consistently shows Unit 280 across all pages. OSM tag likely has a typo; website value used for address.
OSM has no phone number recorded; phone sourced from website only (604-249-0082).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible full-service restaurant with an active website, confirmed phone number, and multiple award recognitions — clearly belongs in the directory.
